setting_get: SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?
refresh_claim: INSERT INTO refreshes(language,last_attempt,lease_until,status,message) VALUES(?,?,?,'running','') ON CONFLICT(language) DO UPDATE SET last_attempt=excluded.last_attempt,lease_until=excluded.lease_until,status='running',message='' WHERE refreshes.lease_until < ? AND refreshes.last_attempt < ?
impressions_expire: DELETE FROM impressions WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM impressions WHERE created_at < ? LIMIT 1000)
sessions_expire: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE created_at < ? LIMIT 1000)
videos_expire: DELETE FROM videos WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM videos WHERE checked_at < ? LIMIT 1000)
sources_enabled: SELECT * FROM sources WHERE language=? AND enabled=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
video_audio_conflict: UPDATE videos SET status='rejected',reason='audio_language_changed',audio_language=?,checked_at=? WHERE id=? AND language IS NOT NULL AND language!=?
video_upsert: INSERT INTO videos(id,title,channel_id,channel_title,language,audio_language,topic,duration,status,published_at,checked_at,reason) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET title=excluded.title,channel_title=excluded.channel_title,audio_language=excluded.audio_language,duration=excluded.duration,published_at=excluded.published_at,checked_at=excluded.checked_at,language=CASE WHEN videos.reason='human_reviewed' AND excluded.status!='rejected' THEN videos.language ELSE excluded.language END,topic=CASE WHEN videos.reason='human_reviewed' THEN videos.topic ELSE excluded.topic END,status=CASE WHEN videos.reason='human_rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN videos.reason='human_reviewed' AND excluded.status!='rejected' AND (excluded.language IS NULL OR excluded.language=videos.language) THEN videos.status ELSE excluded.status END,reason=CASE WHEN videos.reason='human_rejected' THEN 'human_rejected' WHEN videos.reason='human_reviewed' AND excluded.status!='rejected' AND (excluded.language IS NULL OR excluded.language=videos.language) THEN videos.reason ELSE excluded.reason END
refresh_failure: UPDATE refreshes SET lease_until=0,status='failed',message=? WHERE language=?
session_get: SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id=? AND created_at>?
feed_catalogue: SELECT id,title,topic,duration,language,channel_id FROM videos WHERE status='approved' AND language=? AND checked_at>? ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1000
session_seen: SELECT DISTINCT video_id FROM impressions WHERE session_id=? AND displayed=1 AND created_at>?
refresh_status: SELECT last_success,status,message FROM refreshes WHERE language=?
impression_get: SELECT i.*,v.duration FROM impressions i JOIN videos v ON v.id=i.video_id WHERE i.id=? AND i.session_id=? AND i.created_at>?
sources_all: SELECT * FROM sources ORDER BY language,topic
catalogue_counts: SELECT language,status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM videos GROUP BY language,status
interest_metrics: SELECT language,topic,COUNT(*) AS impressions,SUM(watch_seconds) AS watch_seconds,SUM(completed) AS completions FROM impressions WHERE displayed=1 GROUP BY language,topic
setting_put: INSERT INTO settings(key,value) VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value
sources_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sources WHERE language=? AND enabled=1
source_exists: SELECT id FROM sources WHERE id=?
source_enabled: SELECT enabled FROM sources WHERE id=?
source_upsert: INSERT INTO sources(id,channel_id,language,topic,label,enabled) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET topic=excluded.topic,label=excluded.label,enabled=1
source_disable: UPDATE sources SET enabled=0 WHERE id=?
source_unpublish: UPDATE videos SET status='pending',reason='source_disabled' WHERE channel_id=? AND language=?
candidates: SELECT * FROM videos WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 100
video_reject: UPDATE videos SET status='rejected',reason='human_rejected' WHERE id=?
discovery_duration: UPDATE videos SET duration=?2 WHERE id=?1
